# jamfpro_v3_enrollment_access_group (Resource)

Retrieve the configured LDAP groups configured for User-Initiated Enrollment.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) LDAP Group ID
- `ldap_server_id` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `account_driven_user_enrollment_enabled` (Boolean)
- `enterprise_enrollment_enabled` (Boolean)
- `personal_enrollment_enabled` (Boolean)
- `require_eula` (Boolean)
- `site_id` (String)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Autogenerated ID
